content: A hard man is good to find. In a seaside village lost to time, a fisherwoman (Olivia Coleman) delivers the food relied on by the townsfolk, who barely tolerate her cantankerous presence. Unexpectedly named the next to be wed and sick of the disdain, she commissions the local Basketmaker (Peter Dinklage) to weave her the perfect husband (Alexander Skarsgård) and he truly goes above and beyond. When you’re married to the hottest and handiest man around, jealousies inevitably flare up. WICKER releases nationwide across Australia (November 26) & New Zealand (January 7). chineseContent: 难找的人很好找。在一个迷失了时间的海边村庄里，一位渔妇（奥利维亚·科尔曼饰）为镇民们提供赖以生存的食物，而镇民们几乎无法忍受她脾气暴躁的存在。出乎意料的是，她被任命为下一个结婚对象，厌倦了这种蔑视，她委托当地的编篮人（彼特·丁拉基饰）为她编织了一个完美的丈夫（亚历山大·斯卡斯加德饰），而他确实超越了一切。当你嫁给了周围最性感、最方便的男人时，嫉妒不可避免地会爆发。 WICKER 在澳大利亚（11 月 26 日）和新西兰（1 月 7 日）全国上映。关注我们： https://www.instagram.com/roadshow https://www.facebook.com/roadshow
